name: StickStack — Stickers & voice notes for Substack
description: Bring your WhatsApp sticker collection to Substack. Drop stickers into Notes and replies, and send voice notes in DMs. 100% local, open source.

content_security_policy.extension_pages: script-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; connect-src 'self' https://substack-post-media.s3.amazonaws.com; img-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src 'self' blob:; worker-src 'self'

toggle-picker.description: Open the sticker picker in the Substack box you're typing in
